rows.text:
- Independent review by migration_plan_review under the shared Codex identity: target revision 568 and candidate v4 from revision 565; no remaining high-level blocker found.
- API work now shows attach/check/read examples and compiler rejection cases; dependency checks are separate. Runtime/data rehearsal and existing-model-compiler derivation still gate app replacement (R1/R2 preserved).
- All affected active consumers are peers, including storage, planning/review, tools and UI. Later checks explicitly catch saved-query, loaded-data and runtime assumptions that compilation can miss.
- Nine revised steps use four concise bullets; native agent reviews precede bounded human exercises. Accept the planning correction only: detailed API, implementation and test results remain unverified, and human understanding/approval remain the user's decision.
